decisions.decision: Articles 2 and 3 are included in the warrant with their recommendation deferred.
decisions.quote: article 2 - amending the fiscal year 2026 omnibus budget previously voted. included; recommendation deferred.

decisions.decision: Recommendations on Articles 13 and 14 are deferred pending the public hearing scheduled for Monday.
decisions.quote: article 13 - mbta zoning act compliance previously voted. included; recommendation deferred pending the public hearing scheduled for monday.

decisions.decision: The Select Board agreed the holiday pay clarifying language should remain in Article 16.
decisions.quote: after discussion, the select board agreed the language should remain for clarity.

decisions.decision: The Select Board agreed with the underlying concept on promotion and step increases; the Town Manager will work with labor counsel to correct the language, with no additional vote required.
decisions.quote: the town manager indicated she would work with labor counsel to correct the language and confirmed the select board's agreement on the underlying concept, with no additional vote required.

decisions.decision: The Select Board directed that 'doctor's certificate' and 'doctor's note' be harmonized to a single consistent term throughout the Article 16 document.
decisions.quote: the select board directed that "doctor's certificate" and "doctor's note" be harmonized to use a single consistent term throughout the document.

decisions.decision: The cost-of-living recommendation language will specify that it occur at Annual Town Meeting, as the Town Manager confirmed would be incorporated.
decisions.quote: clerk emkey suggested the language specify that this occur at annual town meeting, which the town manager confirmed would be incorporated.

budget_items.quote: the town manager also advised that she had presented the financial impact of this article to the finance committee the prior evening and would provide the select board with a codified cost estimate related to the vacation time changes.
